watch_list.summary: Ask Bot for a page, edit it together, or have it keep the page up to date.
Copy-ready ideas: launch burn-down lists, design docs you iterate with Bot, morning briefs, and weekly what-did-I-get-done.
Three bots split roles and cleared ~204 support tickets in ~10 minutes after an incident, with a person approving before anything sends.
Keep a living page of everything you owe Bot (with sources and diagrams) so it tracks accountability over time.
Let bots keep Pages current and build on them so each one becomes a shareable knowledge base.

trendy.summary: Monday routine: Bot reads your X Money account and writes a deep weekly finance report.
Playbook for webhook vs hourly vs daily vs 5-minute wakes, plus pasteable prompt to rebuild schedules by cost.
Give Bot its own address, forward site contact mail there, summarize (not auto-reply).
Concrete builds: agent status dashboard, live X vs median, content growth by platform.
Bot→CLI easy; Claude→Bot via MCP + webhook routine + Tailscale Funnel.
